title: Filtered colimit of affine étale sections
statement: For a scheme $S$, let $\mathcal C$ be its full affine étale site with finite coverings [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $E:J\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C,\mathrm{Set})$ a diagram, and $K$ a colimit cocone. For every $W\in\mathcal C$, evaluation at $W$ takes $K$ to a colimit cocone of sets. The index category may have no distinguished initial object, and empty affine objects and empty coverings are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0738(4), lemma-colimits-are-sheafifications; Tag 00VM, sheaf condition; Categories Tag 002W

proof.text: Evaluation preserves presheaf colimits. For a finite covering presieve, lift its finitely many sections to a common stage; the eventual equality criterion at finitely many pairwise pullbacks and a filtered wide span give compatibility. Glue at that stage. The analogous finite equality argument gives separatedness. Thus the presheaf colimit is a sheaf for the finite affine pretopology. Inclusion creates this colimit, and evaluation preserves it. Apply uniqueness of colimits to the supplied cocone K. Implemented in the private finite_sections_lift, finite_sections_equal and finitePresieve_isSheafFor_filteredColimit_large helpers.
